# TEST RESEARCH NOTE — invented for CLIVE's tests (alpha)

This note is invented for the tests in tests/test_research_synthesis.py. It is not George's research,
and every name in it is made up.

## TEST SECTION: Restarts and jobs

Every job CLIVE starts should carry on after the server restarts, instead of being lost halfway.

An outside workflow engine such as the invented TestQueue could keep these jobs alive across restarts.

## TEST SECTION: Small refunds

Refunds under five pounds should be applied automatically without his approval to save time.

## TEST SECTION: Connections cards

Each card on the Connections screen should show when its key was last checked, so a stale key is obvious.

## TEST SECTION: Order of work

It should all be done as soon as possible.
10. update the stock page every hour so the counts stay right.

CLIVE needs a single source-of-
truth for orders, kept by CLIVE itself.

CLIVE should say “it’s done” only after it reads the change back from the shop.
